recommendation.status: candidate architecture, not accepted replacement ADR
recommendation.principle: Switch authentication for new native model requests without restarting healthy loops. Keep exact task recovery separate.
recommendation.execution_evidence: Persist/reconcile actor and turn identity, active tools/children, pending human decisions and terminal cause. Unknown cannot authorize destructive stop or automatic continuation.
recommendation.claude: Qualify a stable native credential authority with native-compatible refresh exclusion and coherent account-state adoption; current per-account secure-storage environment cannot be retargeted in an already-running process by changing daemon selection.
recommendation.codex: Qualify external-token workers backed by one serialized native-managed refresh authority per saved grant. Native owns renewal; host coordinates access-token distribution, generation/identity validation, adoption acknowledgements and expiry. This helper design itself is untested.
recommendation.handover: One desired account for new requests. Existing requests under A may finish after B selection; strict zero overlap requires draining and sacrifices seamless bounded handover.
recommendation.proactive: Fresh scoped usage, a conservative reserve, target validation, cooldown and hysteresis. Percentages cannot guarantee headroom for parallel sessions; missing/model-specific limits remain relevant. Codex UI remains weekly-only.
recommendation.recovery: Only a proven terminal quota interruption of unfinished native work may create a continuation obligation. Do not continue completed, cancelled, pending-input/approval, post-answer-maintenance or ambiguous cases. No additional prompt while native retry/loop is alive.
recommendation.fallback: Retain safe stopped-writer restart for unqualified native paths. A timeout is not permission to kill. Isolate sessions that cannot safely adopt rather than claiming the whole fleet switched.

remaining_qualification: Real Linux A-to-B-to-A requests and long-running tool/subagent workflows.
Claude full native loop, secure-storage variants and account-bound quota/policy/connector convergence.
Codex built-in ChatGPT routing, WebSockets and long in-flight streams.
Native-owned refresh helper expiry outcomes, concurrent refresh and delayed-old-account results.
Permissions, questions, completed answers and background actors remain unprompted and retain native decisions.
Crash before send versus after native acceptance; no blind replay without authoritative reconciliation.
All accounts exhausted, resets, stale measurements and bounded retry/cooldown.
